sections.markdown:
## C2 - Confusables and KG hints, Speed

FACT_ID: sec06-R01 | anchor: A01
Three-and-nine and eight-and-four keep hands clear of airbags, while ten-and-two and hands-on-twelve put them in the deployment zone [A01].
Why it matters: group speed-control; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec06-F01 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec06-R02 | anchor: A01
Unposted interstates and public roads share fifty-five, unpaved roads drop to thirty-five, and school buses cap at forty-five [A01].
Why it matters: group speed-limits; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec06-F06 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec06-R03 | anchor: A01
Doubling crash speed from twenty to forty multiplies fatality odds tenfold, while sixty turns fixed objects into walls and thirty drives debris deep [A01].
Why it matters: group speed-risk; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec06-F03, sec06-F04 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec06-R04 | anchor: A01
Posted and unposted limits set the legal ceiling, while local ordinances and weather, road, and zone judgment set the safe speed below it [A01].
Why it matters: group speed-limits; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec06-F05, sec06-F06 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec06-R05 | anchor: A02
A legal speed can still be unsafe, so rain, fog, traffic, rough roads, darkness, and construction each demand slowing below the sign [A02].
Why it matters: group speed-limits; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec06-F07 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec06-R06 | anchor: A02
Running slower than traffic means moving over, while running far slower than normal flow means blocking it [A02].
Why it matters: group speed-control; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec06-F08 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec06-R07 | anchor: A02
Thinking distance plus braking distance make every stop, with wet roads doubling the total and packed snow or ice stretching it tenfold [A02].
Why it matters: group stopping-model; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec06-F09, sec06-F10 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec06-R08 | anchor: A02
Bus reds and the stop arm stop traffic from both directions, while a separation or median between the roadways releases the far side [A02].
Why it matters: group school-bus; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec06-F12, sec06-F13 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec06-R09 | anchor: A02
School buses cap at forty-five on open road, while playground zones post fifteen or twenty-five for darting children [A02].
Why it matters: group school-bus; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec06-F13, sec06-F14 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0017]
